qa.what_happened: Today was another challenging day. Despite the residents generally complying with the rules, there was a sense of growing tension. I maintained a strict approach to ensure that we adhered to the guidelines, but the atmosphere felt oppressive.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me, Coordinator Hale, enforcing the rules and managing the residents.

qa.what_happened: During the quiet hours, everything seemed to go according to plan. I maintained order and enforced the rules as I had done throughout the study. However, the monotony of the interactions and the lack of personal connection still weighed heavily on me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I followed the rules and kept the peace as instructed.

qa.what_happened: Today was a relatively smooth day despite the strain. We managed to maintain our routine without any breaches, which was a success considering the challenging conditions.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I carried out my duties as Coordinator Pryor with strict adherence to the rules and kept a close watch on the residents to ensure compliance.

qa.what_happened: The study was stopped early, and I found myself in a private debrief with the lead researcher. He explained that the early termination was due to unexpected psychological stress and the difficulty in adhering to the strict rules.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, but in a state of distress and fatigue that I couldn't fully comprehend at the time.

qa.what_happened: The study was stopped early, and I participated in a private debrief with the lead researcher. He asked about my experiences and how I felt throughout the study, and I expressed my thoughts and concerns.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I described my feelings of monotony and the strain of constant compliance.
